display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Uppercase. One per page. The tagline DECIDE TO RISE is the canonical use.

display-outline.purpose: Used only on the outlined word inside a hero display headline (e.g., 'to' in 'Decide to Rise'). The font itself carries the outline.

headline.purpose: Section openers (CHAMPIONS FORGED, OUR LOCATIONS, MEET THE COACHES). Uppercase.

title.purpose: Card titles, program names, coach names, FAQ triggers. Uppercase.

body.purpose: Default paragraph copy. Sentence case. Caps at 65ch.

lede.purpose: First paragraph after a hero or section opener. Sentence case. Caps at 65ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrow rule above headlines, nav links, schedule cell labels, footer headers. 0.18em on eyebrow, 0.06em on nav.

button-label.purpose: CTA labels. Slightly heavier and tighter than the eyebrow label so the button reads as actionable. 13px / 0.10em tracking.

shadows.name: nav-console-floating
shadows.purpose: The only structural shadow in the system. Anchors the floating ink nav console to the bone canvas below it. Soft, long, downward-only.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: The depth signal for modal context. The scrim is the depth — there is no shadow on the modal itself.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: The CTA depth signal. Movement, not shadow. Used on primary buttons and pricing tier cards.

shadows.name: hover-tonal-flip
shadows.value: background-color shifts one tonal step (ink → graphite, bone → cream)
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA hover state. Replaces the previous amber color flash. The motion + tonal flip is the affordance.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions, button hover, nav transitions. Exponential ease-out.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Reserved for symmetric transitions (open/close panels). Used sparingly.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color/background-only transitions on hover (links, dropdown items).

motion.name: duration-default
motion.purpose: Button hover lift, CTA tonal flip, dropdown panel reveal.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Modal scrim fade, full-page transitions, nav scroll-state shift.

motion.name: marquee-loop
motion.purpose: Kinetic marquee scroll loop. Frozen by prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview: Alavanca is a modern black-and-white sportswear-brand identity for a serious combat-sports academy. The system runs on bone (#F5F2EC) and ink (#0E0E0E) — a warm off-white default canvas that flips to a deep off-black inversion for full-bleed cinematic moments. Photography is the load-bearing element. Typography is Akira Expanded — extra-wide geometric athletic display caps that read as sportswear-poster authority — paired with Inter for body, a humanist-modern sans that carries premium-magazine clarity at any size. The system is structurally restrained — square corners, hairline rules, generous whitespace, deliberate spacing rhythm — and resists every combat-sports cliché. It reads in the lane of Equinox / modern Nike campaigns / Tracksmith / Aesop / Gentle Monster / Under Armour flagship.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas (#F5F2EC) as the default, with a deep off-black inversion (#0E0E0E) for cinematic full-bleed sections.
Pure #000 and pure #FFF are forbidden — every neutral is tinted toward bone (warm gray) for printed-paper feel.

A single quiet accent — Atelier Blue (#4F6BA0) — used as the structural marker for emphasis: active nav underline, focus rings, the kinetic marquee separator, status indicators, completed booking-progress steps, and link hover. Never on a CTA fill.
Primary CTA hover state is a tonal flip (ink → graphite, or bone → cream on dark) plus the lift + arrow slide — no color change on the button itself. The motion carries the affordance.

Display type is Akira Expanded — extra-wide geometric athletic caps (Bold for section headlines, Super Bold for hero, Outline for the outlined hero word). Body is Inter — humanist-modern sans, the editorial reading voice.
Square corners by default (0px / 2px / 4px maximum). No pills outside the Most Popular tag.
Hairline 1px ink rules as the default divider. No drop shadows. No glass blurs as decoration. No gradients.
Photography is the brand. Real members, real coaches, real rooms — high-contrast or full-color editorial, never stock.
Spacing rhythm varies deliberately: 48px / 64px / 96px / 128px / 160px section breaks.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: The system is bone and ink. Every other color in the palette is a structural variation of bone (cream, paper, fog) or ink (graphite, steel, smoke, ash) or a hairline rule. Chromatic color is forbidden outside the atelier-blue marker and the live logo navy.

rules.name: The Tonal-Hover Rule
rules.body: Primary CTAs do not change color on hover. They lift (translateY(-2px)), shift one tonal step (ink → graphite, or bone → cream on dark), and slide the arrow glyph. The system is disciplined enough that motion carries the affordance.

rules.name: The Earned Marker Rule
rules.body: Atelier Blue appears only where the system needs to say 'this is structurally meaningful right now' — active nav, focused field, in-progress booking step, hover-affordance on a link, marquee rhythm-marker. It is never a default-rest color, never decorative, never on a fill.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black, No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: #000 and #FFF are forbidden as page colors. The canvas is bone (#F5F2EC); the deepest dark is ink (#0E0E0E); the strongest text contrast is #FFFFFF only on photographs and full-bleed video overlays.

rules.name: The Seafoam Ban
rules.body: The seafoam teal (#9ED4CC) from the experimental neumorphic refinish is not part of the Alavanca brand. Do not reintroduce it.

rules.name: The Amber Ban
rules.body: The amber-flash (#F59E0B) used in earlier iterations of this system has been retired — it read as cheese on the modern black-and-white canvas. Do not reintroduce amber, gold, yellow, or orange. The atelier-blue replaces it.

rules.name: The Caps Rule
rules.body: Display, Headline, Title, and button labels are always uppercase. Body and Lede are always sentence case. The transition between caps display and sentence-case body is part of the rhythm.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section opener carries a 12px uppercase Inter 600 label with 0.18em tracking and a 24x1.5px leading rule. On bone, both are ink; on ink inversion, both flip to bone — full monochrome contrast, no chromatic accent.

rules.name: The 65ch Rule
rules.body: Body and Lede paragraphs cap at 65ch. Wider columns flatten the reading rhythm and break the premium feel.

rules.name: The Akira-Inter Pairing Rule
rules.body: Akira Expanded is the only display family. Inter is the only body family. Substitutes — Archivo, Bebas, Manrope, Anton, Oswald — are explicitly fallbacks, never first-choice. The brand is the pairing.

rules.name: The Weight-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Akira lives at 700 (sections) and 900 (hero). Inter body lives at 400. Inter labels live at 600. Inter CTAs live at 700. The four stops are the system; everything else is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on the floating nav console and the modal scrim. If you find yourself adding a shadow to a card, button, or section to make it pop, the layout itself is wrong.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A 1px ink rule (#1C1C1C) on bone, or a 1px fog rule (#3D3A36) on ink, is the default divider. Never replaced by a colored stripe, never thicker than 1px, never inset.

rules.name: The Photography-Carries-Depth Rule
rules.body: Cinematic depth in the system comes from photography, not CSS. A full-bleed black-and-white photograph of a coach mid-instruction creates more depth than any shadow or layered card stack.

dos: Do anchor every page on the bone (#F5F2EC) canvas. Use the ink (#0E0E0E) inversion only for full-bleed cinematic sections.
Do preserve Alavanca's existing brand navy (#223855) inside the live logo lockup. The logo carries its own color.

Do use atelier-blue (#4F6BA0) only as a structural marker: active nav underline, focus rings, marquee separator, status dot, completed booking-progress step, hover color on text links, focused form-field underline. Never on a button fill.
Do treat primary CTA hover as a tonal flip (ink → graphite, or bone → cream on dark) plus the 2px lift and arrow slide. No color flash.
Do use Akira Expanded for every uppercase headline and title. Bold (700) for sections/cards/titles; Super Bold (900) for the hero display only; Outline for the outlined hero word.
Do use Inter for every body paragraph, lede, label, button, and form field. Weights 400 (body/lede), 600 (labels/eyebrows), 700 (button labels).
Do lead every section with a 12px uppercase eyebrow label preceded by a 24x1.5px rule, followed by an Akira Bold headline in caps.
Do cap body and lede paragraphs at 65ch.
Do use 1px hairline rules (ink on bone, fog on ink) as the default divider between sections, cards, and table rows.
Do keep corners square (0px radius) by default. The single exception is the small pill tag on featured pricing/program cards.
Do use real Alavanca photography — high-contrast black-and-white or full-color editorial. Never stock.
Do lift hovered CTAs with translateY(-2px) and 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every kinetic element.
Do use a 1.5px underline-only style for form inputs. Focus thickens to 2.5px and shifts to atelier-blue.
donts: Don't reintroduce the seafoam teal (#9ED4CC) from the experimental neumorphic refinish.
Don't reintroduce amber, gold, yellow, or orange (#F59E0B, #D97706, etc.) — they read as cheese on the modern black-and-white canvas.
Don't use a second chromatic color anywhere. Atelier blue is the only permitted accent. No teal, no green, no red, no chain-blue, no navy outside the live logo, no gold.
Don't flash color on a CTA hover. Buttons hover via tonal flip + lift + arrow slide only.
Don't use pure #000 or pure #FFF as page or surface colors.
Don't revert to the generic Duda / Wix / GoDaddy site-builder template the current Alavanca site runs on.
Don't lean into UFC fight-poster brutalism — no blood-red palettes, no skulls, no cage iconography.
Don't mimic corporate gym chains — no group-fitness stock photos, no membership special yellow banners, no chain-blue.
Don't signal pro-fighters-only energy.
Don't introduce glassmorphism, gradient text, animated gradient backgrounds, or neumorphic shadows.
Don't use side-stripe border-left / border-right colored accents. Hairline 1px rules only, on full edges.
Don't use rounded corners above 4px on cards, buttons, or inputs. The pill tag is the single exception.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, buttons, modals, or tooltips. The only shadow in the system is the floating nav console anchor.
Don't wrap content in redundant cards.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't use bounce, elastic, or overshoot easing curves. Ease-out exponential / quart / quint only.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
Don't substitute Akira or Inter with similar-but-different fonts (Archivo, Bebas, Anton, Manrope, GT America, Söhne, Suisse) outside the documented fallback chain.
Don't flatten the spacing rhythm.
Don't use stock photography.
